evidence_items.text:
Dave: Yeah, that mix really keeps me motivated and makes it all worthwhile.
[S4T15] (dia_id: D4:15)

Calvin: Keep going for it!
[S4T16] (dia_id: D4:16)

Dave: I will! By the way, This is a photo of my shop. Come by sometime, if you can!
[Image caption: a photo of a group of people standing in front of a car]
[S4T17] (dia_id: D4:17)

Calvin: Wow, your shop looks great! I'd love to check it out sometime. What sort of cars do you work on at your shop?
[S4T18] (dia_id: D4:18)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I work on all kinds of cars at the shop - from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars. It keeps me busy and happy!
[S4T19] (dia_id: D4:19)

Calvin: Wow Dave, working on cars must be really rewarding.
[S4T20] (dia_id: D4:20)

Dave: Definitely, working on cars is what I'm passionate about. Doing it every day is so rewarding! Seeing the transformation is awesome and knowing I'm helping people keep their cars in good condition is really satisfying.
[S4T21] (dia_id: D4:21)

Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Doing something you love and helping others is so rewarding. Keep up the great work!
[S4T22] (dia_id: D4:22)

Dave: Thanks, Cal! I really appreciate the boost. It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others.
[S4T23] (dia_id: D4:23)

Calvin: Glad to help, Dave! So awesome to see you doing your thing and making a difference. Your hard work and talent totally deserve all the recognition. Keep on keepin' on, bud! Take a look at this beautiful necklace with a diamond pendant, that's so stunning!
[Image caption: a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant]
[S4T24] (dia_id: D4:24)

- On 2023-10-08, told Calvin that last Friday (2023-10-06) he went to a car show — saw "awesome cars," got to "mess with car mods," and there were "so many cool machines around" — "it was so much fun!"; shared a photo of "this beautiful car" (a photography of two men looking at a car engine); Calvin: "I'm into the rush of awesome cars. Can't wait to check out your garage." (continuing his habit of attending car shows, see above) [S22T1][S22T2].
- On 2023-10-08, described the car from his 2023-10-06 car-show photo: he "restored and modified it myself," adding a custom exhaust and some performance upgrades; it's "got a sweet sound" and he's "really proud of how it turned out"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!" [S22T3][S22T4].
- On 2023-10-25, shared a photo of his latest car project (a group of people washing a car in a garage); Calvin: "that car looks awesome!" and asked what got him into engineering cars [S26T4][S26T5].
- On 2023-10-25, when asked (by Calvin) what got him into engineering cars, gave a second, complementary origin story: cars have "always been [his] thing" — his dad took him to his first car show when he was 10, he was "wow-ed," and "I was hooked and wanted to learn more"; now he's an automotive engineer, and it's "crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts" (complements the 2023-10-23 origin story — fascination with machines at ten and the neighbor's old car — in the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of this file; Calvin: "So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music.") [S26T6][S26T7].
- On 2023-10-25, Calvin: "I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models" — a shared car passion (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S26T5].
- On 2023-10-29, when Calvin asked how the car project was going, told him "The car project is doing well" — he "just finished restoring it and it looks amazing" — and invited Calvin over to check it out ("Wanna come by and check it out?") (Calvin: "That's awesome, Dave! Your car project sounds amazing."); the restoration is of the current/latest car project he shared on 2023-10-25 (photo of people washing a car in a garage) — i.e., the new, challenging black-car project he mentioned on 2023-10-23 (see above) [S27T9][S27T10].
- On 2023-11-02, told Calvin that the car mod he featured in his blog post — the one that made his car "look like a beast" (see ## Car mod blog) — "was a lot of work, but I think it was worth it in the end" (shared a photo of a blue Subaru parked in a parking lot); when Calvin asked how the car's headlights got to look so good ("those headlights look great! What did you do to get them looking so good?"), Dave: "I spent a lot of time cleaning, polishing, and protecting them - they look great!" (shared a photo of a blue car parked on a road at night — "these headlights are enchanting!"); Calvin: "Wow, they look great! You really put in a lot of effort. Well done!"; Dave: "Thanks, Calvin! Really appreciate you noticing the effort I put into this." [S28T10][S28T14][S28T15][S28T16][S28T17][S28T18].
- On 2023-11-02, in the same conversation, shared a photo of a red car (a red car with a black engine and a red hood); when Calvin asked where he got it ("Thanks! Where did you get this car?"), Dave: he "found it last week" (~late October 2023), "it was in bad shape, but I saw the potential," and he "spent ages restoring it"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave, that is an awesome job on restoring it! You've got some serious skills!"; Dave: "Thanks Calvin! It took some work, but I'm happy with the result" (an additional restored car on top of the ongoing project car detailed above — possibly the car he reported as "just finished restoring" on 2023-10-29, though it does not match the black project car from 2023-10-23, so the identification is unconfirmed; Calvin's side in the 2023-11-02 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/calvin.md) [S28T18][S28T19][S28T20][S28T21][S28T22].

Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo.
[Image caption: a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it]
[S4T1] (dia_id: D4:1)

Calvin: Wow Dave! Congrats on opening your own car maintenance shop! It looks like all your hard work and dedication paid off.
[Image caption: a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage]
[S4T2] (dia_id: D4:2)

Dave: Thanks, Cal! It's great to see my hard work paying off. Opening this shop was my dream, and I'm really happy to see it getting started. It was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it.
[S4T3] (dia_id: D4:3)

Calvin: Woo, Dave! Congrats on achieving your dream - you've got guts and ambition - that's awesome! Keep it up!
[Image caption: a photo of a book with a space theme on it]
[S4T4] (dia_id: D4:4)

Dave: Thanks! Appreciate the support. My dream was to open a shop and it's a step towards my other dream of working on classic cars. I love their design and engineering.
[S4T5] (dia_id: D4:5)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! Going for it with classic cars is cool! Fulfilling your dreams is so important.
[Image caption: a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot]
[S4T6] (dia_id: D4:6)

Dave: I'm obsessed with classic cars. They have a unique charm. I was so thrilled to restore one last year—nothing like bringing it back to life! Take a look at the engine of the restored car.
[Image caption: a photo of a car engine with a small air filter]
[S4T7] (dia_id: D4:7)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! That looks awesome!
[S4T8] (dia_id: D4:8)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It was a labor of love. Challenging, but so worth it.
[S4T9] (dia_id: D4:9)

Calvin: Yeah, it's awesome when you see something you worked on come to life.
[S4T10] (dia_id: D4:10)

Dave: Yeah! It feels great to see the hard work pay off, it's like bringing something back to life.
[S4T11] (dia_id: D4:11)

Calvin: Yeah, it's an amazing feeling when you create something and it resonates with people. It's so satisfying when you finish something you made from scratch!
[S4T12] (dia_id: D4:12)

- By 2023-05-01, had finally opened his own car maintenance shop — called it a dream come true; "so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars"; it was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it [S4T1][S4T3].
- Shared a photo of the shop (a car dealership with cars parked in front) [S4T1].
- Opening the shop was his dream and is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars [S4T3][S4T5].
- Calvin congratulated him, said his hard work and dedication paid off, praised his "guts and ambition", and told him to keep it up [S4T2][S4T4].

Dave: That's cool. Using your music to share experiences and feelings, is it cathartic for you?
[S25T11] (dia_id: D25:11)

Calvin: Yeah, it's a way for me to express myself and work through my emotions. It's like my own form of therapy.
[S25T12] (dia_id: D25:12)

Dave: Yeah, I get it. Cars give me an outlet to express myself. It's like a little oasis of calm. Whenever I'm working on one, it's like I'm connecting back with myself. And yeah, the music helps too! Look at my garage, a little dirty, but everything is in its place.
[Image caption: a photography of a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall]
[S25T13] (dia_id: D25:13)

Calvin: Looking cool - what made you start working on cars?
[S25T14] (dia_id: D25:14)

Dave: Ever since I was ten, I've been fascinated with how machines work. I found an old car in a neighbor's garage and asked if I could fix it. That's when my love for car engineering began! I enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made me hooked—so I've been working on cars ever since.
[Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car in a garage]
[S25T15] (dia_id: D25:15)

Calvin: Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life. Was it a classic car? Do you still have it or are you currently working on another project?
[S25T16] (dia_id: D25:16)

Dave: Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector. Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge! Take a look at this wonderful car!
[Image caption: a photo of a black car parked in a parking lot]
[S25T17] (dia_id: D25:17)

Calvin: Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?
[S25T18] (dia_id: D25:18)

Dave: It takes a lot of patience, but the payoff is worth it. Paying extra attention to detail isn't easy, but it pays off.
[S25T19] (dia_id: D25:19)

Calvin: Yeah, details can really make a difference. It's what makes something great, like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car.
[S25T20] (dia_id: D25:20)

Dave: Yeah, for sure Calvin! Paying attention to details makes a big difference, whether it's in music or with vehicles. Little things can make a big impact!
[S25T21] (dia_id: D25:21)

Calvin: Yeah, Dave! Paying attention to those small details makes a difference. Without them, it's just average. As an artist, I want to create something extraordinary!
[Image caption: a photo of a silver disc in a black frame on a table]
[S25T22] (dia_id: D25:22)

- Shared a photo of himself standing in front of a car on a lift at the workshop [S13T1].
- Shared a photo of the "really thrilling part of the workshop" — a mechanic working on a car — saying "seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying" [S13T5].
- Current car project: has been doing engine swaps and suspension modifications, and is now learning body modifications; the project is giving a classic muscle car a modern twist — "a challenge but so fun" — and shared a photo of a silver Corvette parked in front of a building; Calvin praised the modern twist the silver finish gives [S13T7][S13T8].
- Later in the same 2023-08-11 conversation, Dave explained the project's goal: he wanted "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style", and is "really happy with it"; "It's all about those small details that make it unique and personalized", and the project is about showing his style — "it's like customizing a work of art on wheels"; Calvin praised the work and attention to detail ("You've really put in some work! That attention to detail is great"), agreed the small details are what make a masterpiece unique and personalized, and told Dave to "keep coming up with new cool stuff, bud", saying he's excited to see what Dave will do next [S13T9][S13T10][S13T11][S13T12][S13T13][S13T14].
- On 2023-08-14, told Calvin the project is "going great" and shared a photo of the car he's restoring (a car with a broken engine in the woods) — "It's pretty cool seeing it go from a beat-up mess to a real beauty." Calvin asked how long it would take to restore; Dave hopes it'll be all fixed up by the end of next month (end of September 2023): "Lots of elbow grease but it'll be worth the transformation." [S14T11][S14T12][S14T13]
- On 2023-09-15, told Calvin it's "been awesome": "Been restoring this vintage beauty" and shared the "final result" photo — a man standing next to a classic car — implying the restoration he had been updating Calvin on since 2023-08-14 (above) is now finished, ahead of his earlier hope (stated 2023-08-14) to have it done by the end of September 2023; Calvin: "Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?" [S19T7][S19T8]; Dave: "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9].
- On 2023-09-22, reported a setback on the vintage Mustang (the restoration car he had been updating Calvin on — see above; he had shown the "final result" on 2023-09-15): he had been working on the engine and thought he'd fixed it, but when he started the car up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in"; shared a photo of the engine (a car engine with a small engine) and asked Calvin "Take a look at the engine!" [S20T1].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Car mod blog (new as of 2023-11-02)
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-11-02, told Calvin he recently started a blog on car mods — "It's my way to share my passion with others" — and asked Calvin for blogging tips (unanswered in this excerpt), sharing a photo of a car website design (Calvin's side in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S28T8].
- On 2023-11-02, when Calvin asked whether the blog had any success stories of inspiring others yet: it's awesome that "people are checking out my blog and asking me for advice"; he recently posted about how he made his car "look like a beast," and it was great to hear it "inspired others to start their own DIY projects" (shared a photo of a blue Subaru parked in a parking lot; the car mod behind the post — including Calvin's follow-up about the headlights — is detailed in the Classic cars section of this file) [S28T9][S28T10].
- On 2023-11-02, Calvin: "Your blog is awesome. Helping others get creative is awesome. Keep up the great work!"; Dave: it's "fulfilling to share my knowledge and help others unleash their creativity"; Calvin: "keep doing what you do! Your blog and car mods are inspiring and a great way to help people find their creativity" [S28T11][S28T12][S28T13].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked "what made you start working on cars?") that his car passion started when he was ten: he'd been fascinated with how machines work, found an old car in a neighbor's garage, and asked if he could fix it — "that's when my love for car engineering began!" — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; comes with his remark that working on a car is his outlet — "a little oasis of calm" — where he's "connecting back with myself" — see the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; complements the childhood memories of tinkering with engines in his dad's garage recorded above; Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life.", and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is working on another project — Dave answered in the continuation of the same day's chat, which is not in this excerpt: he restored a car last year (2022, the 2022 restoration, see above) but sold it to a collector, and is now working on a new car project he finds quite a challenge [S25T14][S25T15][S25T16][S25T17].
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked what the toughest part of car restoration is) that it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off — echoing his earlier remarks that small details make his mod project unique and personalized (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) and that the small successes make him proud (see above) [S25T18][S25T19].
- On 2023-10-25, said working on a car project "takes me out of my head and calms me down" — complementing his long-stated "oasis of calm"/therapy remarks above [S26T4].
- As of 2023-10-29, is also getting into photography (a new hobby — details and the Boston photos he shared are in the Photography section below) [S27T2][S27T8].
